title: OJCP AgentDeclaration
description: Schema for agent self-identification when initiating applications. Enables employer audit trails, rate limiting, and abuse prevention.

agent_id.description: Reverse-domain-notation identifier for the agent (e.g., com.apple.intelligence.jobseeker). Self-asserted unless the request is signed. A signed request's agent_id MUST be lowercase LDH hostname labels joined by '.', and binds to the Signature-Agent origin when the origin's reversed host prefixes it (spec § Identity Binding). Not enforced here, so unsigned requests are unaffected.

agent_version.description: Version string of the agent software.

acting_on_behalf_of.description: Who the agent is acting on behalf of.

user_consent_token.description: Optional token representing user or operator authorization. For 'autonomous' interaction modes, this represents the operator's authorization rather than per-action user consent. Token format and verification are provider-defined.

interaction_mode.description: How the agent interacts with the user during the apply flow. 'assisted' = user confirms key steps, 'autonomous' = fully hands-off, 'supervised' = user monitors but does not intervene.

user_mandate.description: Optional user mandate: a credential, SHOULD be a compact SD-JWT VC presented with a key-binding proof, by which the user authorizes the agent signing key named in its cnf.jkt claim to perform one OJCP action, bound to a canonical action statement (resource server, employer when multi-tenant, tool, job, agent key, and for submit_application the application_id, candidate-data digest and provider-issued mandate_nonce). Proves the user authorized THIS action, as distinct from acting_on_behalf_of (a self-asserted hint), which MUST NOT be treated as delegated user authority. Providers evaluate it only on a request with a verified agent identity. See spec § User Mandates.
